model_name: Orbital Economy v7.7.6 r1 — Ore Capital
notes: v7.7.6: ore mining capacity is simple capital (a simple_capital node per colony, model/nodes/ore-mine.json), sized to a new smoothed ore demand-signal stock; the last constant-capacity process under Planet v1 P2. See docs/tasks/019-ore-capital/.

Modes 0-39 reproduce v7.7.5 r1 exactly (Ore Capital Enabled = 0); Mode 40 baseline (A mine grows past 70, B winds down), Mode 41 transport surge in which colony B rebuilds its ore mine and draws its ore inventory down.
Exact numbers are defined on the canonical platform (docs/VERSIONING_AND_AUTHORITY.md section 8); series-digest.windows.json is the golden.
